headline: China Tightens Indium Export Controls Amid Rising AI Demand
summary: China has implemented stricter export controls on indium, a critical metal essential for displays and advanced semiconductors, linking the action directly to escalating global AI demand. This move intensifies resource geopolitics and directly impacts the global supply chain for key AI infrastructure components and semiconductor manufacturing.

headline: G7 Launches Coordinated Push on Critical Minerals, Targeting AI and Chip Supply Chain Risks
summary: The G7's strategic initiative to secure critical mineral supplies directly addresses vulnerabilities in the global AI and semiconductor supply chains. This move intensifies geopolitical competition for resource control and accelerates efforts to diversify away from current dominant suppliers, impacting rare earth markets and global logistics.

headline: US-Iran Pact Redefines Middle East Energy Geopolitics and Global Supply Chains
summary: A newly reported US-Iran pact signals the resolution of a significant regional conflict, fundamentally reshaping energy maps and easing prior crises. This major geopolitical shift will stabilize energy markets, impact global trade routes, and indirectly reduce supply chain risks for critical tech industries.
